## Today, nobody can tell if your books changed {#problem}

<span class="kicker">The problem</span>

<div class="cards">
<div class="card card--clay"><h3>Closing is manual</h3><p>Stripe, spreadsheets and a bookkeeper. Every month-end is hand work.</p></div>
<div class="card card--clay"><h3>Edits leave no trace</h3><p>Books can be changed quietly, and nobody outside can tell.</p></div>
<div class="card card--clay"><h3>An email isn't proof</h3><p>Payers get a Stripe email, not a receipt anyone can check.</p></div>
</div>

<p class="fine">Meanwhile QuickBooks, Xero and FreshBooks all raised prices in 2026, and QuickBooks caps users on every plan.</p>
